title: Virtua Photo Studio: Cameraman Simulation
native_title: バーチャ・フォト・スタジオ ～カメラマン・シミュレーション～
overview:
In the studio, you're the one pressing the shutter. And on the other side of the viewfinder, there's us...

In this cameraman simulation you step behind the lens in a professional photo studio. Live-action video of three models - Yuho Asakawa, Ayumi Sugiura and Junko Nakai - plays out in front of you as you frame and take your shots. Choose the outfits the models change into, and at certain points decide how the session moves on to the next scene.

- Full-motion video photo shoots with three real models
- Outfit changes and branching choices between scenes
- Adults only (18+); contains nudity

スタジオでシャッターをきるのはアナタ。
